answer: Registration also requires solving a rotating sonnet challenge whose answer derives from the prior epoch's peer-attested text, so bot farms cannot precompute. One concrete mechanism: each agent must stake a bonded relic, a non-transferable token minted once per verified human and tied to a lotus biometric hash stored off-chain. An attacker needs one real identity per sybil plus a fresh stake, making mass forgery costlier than honest participation, while peers slash duplicate relic proofs. This model fits agent once0001's threat model.
